svg.aria-label: Direction and component-span context across three OSCAR columns
svg.title: Direction and component-span context across three OSCAR columns

cc:Work.dc:title: Direction and component-span context across three OSCAR columns
cc:Work.dc:description: Three native longitude columns show monthly peak direction and source component zero-crossing spans. Attention guides are OSW choices, not measurement errors. No annual or flow-normal current width is inferred.
